message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the loaded CSV data or dataset inputs before use.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local hard-coded paths and torchvision's MNIST downloader with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: The code loads labels directly from CSV files and passes them to datasets without any validation of label values against an expected set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data before it is passed to the model; data is loaded and used as-is.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models via create_model and load_checkpoint/resume_checkpoint helpers but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible anywhere in the provided code slices.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, verifies expected label sets, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism is used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolated from training, no data hashing/signing, and validation data is simply split from the training set via split_validation(), offering no protection against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code passes data directly from data loaders to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation on inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are passed directly to metric functions (argmax, AUC, etc.) with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation before use.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline handles image classification tasks (Cassava, MNIST, RANZCR), not LLM text generation, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
